title: Across and Back
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：across　|　正文 307 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 across 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Across, in 1987 the musician carried the score at the piano, and everybody in the hall said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning: the musician had carried the score ② across at once, and nobody had asked a single question. The musician had come to the hall two nights earlier, and spoke little of the hall he had left behind him.

The programme for December 1981 puts it plainer. The score was ③ across, and the listener who kept it wrote of the score ④ across in the same line; nothing in the hall was ever left across for long in those days. The listener wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every night thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ across, and ⑥ Across came the listener who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the hall had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1994 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was that the score be played ⑦ across at the piano, and that everybody be ⑧ across before the December rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried across.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1997 she carried the score  across in the rain when nobody else would, and  Across, she said in 1999, that was the part the hall never forgot; the programme still speaks of it across. She kept the score in the same piano for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the hall never forgot how across it had all been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 横过（句末状语，置于宾语之后：carried the score across，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 横过（作表语，说明处所或去向：the score was across）
C. adv. 在对面（置于句首：Across, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 在对面（作后置定语，紧跟被修饰的名词：the score across）
E. adv. 在对面（作介词宾语：from across）
F. adv. 在对面（句首强调，引起全部倒装：Across came the listener）
G. adv. 横过（被动结构中置于过去分词之后：be played across at the piano）
H. adv. 横过（be across 说明所在或去向：everybody be across before the rains）

answers.why: across 意为“在对面”，此处置于句首交代地点或去向：Across, in 1987 …。
across 意为“横过”，此处置于宾语之后作状语：had carried the score across。
across 意为“横过”，此处作表语说明那件薄薄的乐谱的去向或所在：was across。
across 意为“在对面”，此处作后置定语紧跟名词：the score across。
across 意为“在对面”，此处作介词 from 的宾语：from across。
across 意为“在对面”，此处置于句首引起全部倒装：Across came the listener。
across 意为“横过”，被动结构中副词置于过去分词之后：be played across at the piano。
across 意为“横过”，be across 说明众人须在雨季前到达某处或处于某状态。
